description: Verify a paycheck's take-home pay in three stages: IRS Publication 15-T percentage-method federal withholding (ART-338), FICA and net-pay computation (ART-339), then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). Federal taxes only; state and local withholding are out of scope. Not tax advice.
name: paycheck-take-home-check

steps.handoff: Produces federal_withholding_per_period via the IRS Publication 15-T percentage method; tax_year is declared identically on both compute nodes
Produces net_pay with the FICA breakdown; the run's execution_hash anchors this stage
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Take-Home Pay Check
